Beach on Scenic Highway 30A Welcome to Sea La Vie, a premier Seagrove Beach vacation rental on Scenic Highway 30A, where elevated coastal design meets relaxed beach living. Ideally located just steps from the sugar white sand and emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico, this stunning home offers everything guests look for when booking a luxury 30A vacation rental with a large private pool and golf cart. With accommodations for up to sixteen guests, Sea La Vie is perfect for family vacations, multi-family trips, group getaways, and special celebrations along Florida’s Emerald Coast. Elevated Interiors with Spa-Inspired Design Sea La Vie has been thoughtfully updated with professionally designed interiors and elevated finishes throughout, creating a refined coastal retreat that feels both modern and inviting. The home features updated flooring, beautifully remodeled bathrooms, and an additional bathroom, providing added comfort and functionality for larger groups. Each bathroom is designed with spa-inspired elements, including custom tile work, high-end fixtures, and calming coastal tones that create a relaxing, resort-style experience. From the curated furnishings to the light-filled spaces, every detail has been carefully selected to deliver a luxury 30A experience. Open Concept Living Designed for Gathering Step inside and experience a bright, spacious open concept living area designed for connection and comfort. Large windows fill the home with natural light, while coastal finishes and plush seating create a warm, inviting atmosphere. The living room flows seamlessly into the dining and kitchen areas, making it the perfect place for gathering after a day at the beach or pool. A second living area provides additional space for movie nights, games, or quiet relaxation. Gourmet Kitchen for Entertaining The fully stocked kitchen is designed to accommodate both casual meals and entertaining with ease. Kitchen features include: • High-end appliances • Large island with bar seating • Generous counter space for meal preparation • Full sets of cookware, bakeware, and utensils • Small appliances including blender and crockpot The adjacent dining area comfortably seats ten, making it ideal for family meals and group gatherings. Spacious Bedroom Layout for Comfort and Privacy Sea La Vie offers five beautifully appointed bedrooms designed to provide both privacy and comfort. Primary King Suite - First Floor • Spa-inspired ensuite bathroom with garden tub and walk-in shower • Elegant finishes and relaxing atmosphere Second King Suite - First Floor • Private ensuite bathroom with walk-in shower Third King Suite - Second Floor • Private ensuite bathroom with double vanity and balcony overlooking the pool Fourth King Bedroom - Second Floor • Private bathroom located just outside the bedroom Bunk Room - First Floor • Six XL twin beds • Perfect for children and teens Each bedroom is thoughtfully designed with comfortable bedding, Smart TVs, and coastal décor. Private Backyard Oasis with Pool The outdoor space at Sea La Vie is designed for relaxation, entertainment, and making memories. The large private pool can be heated in season and is surrounded by lounge seating and palm trees, creating a true backyard retreat. Outdoor features include: • Covered patio seating • Outdoor dining area • Grill for family cookouts • Cornhole and poolside games • Basketball hoop and pool toys After a day at the beach, rinse off in the outdoor shower before relaxing poolside. Golf Cart Included and Easy Beach Access Sea La Vie includes a 6-seater street legal golf cart at no additional cost, making trips to the beach and around 30A effortless and convenient. Guests can also enjoy: • Four beach cruiser bikes • Up to fifteen beach chairs • One beach umbrella Santa Clara Beach Access is just steps away, offering one of the most convenient and beautiful beach access points on 30A. Prime Location Near Seaside and 30A Attractions Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach, Sea La Vie places guests minutes from the best of Scenic Highway 30A. Nearby destinations include: • Seaside • Seagrove Beach restaurants and cafés • Scenic 30A bike path • Boutique shopping and local markets • Coastal dune lakes and outdoor adventures This central location allows guests to experience everything that makes 30A one of the most sought-after vacation destinations in the United States. Thoughtful Amenities for a Seamless Stay Every stay includes a complimentary starter package with: • Starbucks coffee and creamer • Bottled water • Kitchen essentials and spices • Paper goods and cleaning supplies • Shampoo, conditioner, and bath amenities These details allow guests to settle in immediately and begin enjoying their vacation. Book Your Luxury 30A Vacation at Sea La Vie With its unbeatable Seagrove Beach location, private heated pool, spa-inspired interiors, included golf cart, and spacious layout, Sea La Vie stands out as one of the top luxury vacation rentals on 30A. Whether you are relaxing by the pool, exploring Scenic Highway 30A, or enjoying the beach just steps away, every moment at Sea La Vie is designed to deliver an unforgettable experience. Book your stay today and experience the very best of Seagrove Beach, Scenic Highway 30A, and Florida’s Emerald Coast.
